limitations: Two resident models, each with20residentworkerthreads and one sharedKVstore; sequential warmed inference in alternating order. OFF also retains the idle12pool. No direct deployed-f17 timing comparison in this report. Direct acknowledged/closed dumps preserve worker pools after warmup. No OS cache eviction or hard host isolation. Full-logit bits and fixed greedy IDs must match; separate causal/cache/sampled verification gates required.
